items.title: Seven-Year Valve Durability With Transcatheter or Surgical Aortic Valve Replacement: An Ad Hoc Analysis of the PARTNER 3 Randomized Clinical Trial
items.title_zh: PARTNER 3随机对照试验7年随访事后分析(JAMA Cardiology,n=948,TAVR 495例 vs 外科手术453例):低危重度症状性主动脉瓣狭窄患者中,TAVR与外科瓣膜7年结构性瓣膜退化、瓣膜衰败及再干预发生率均低且两组相近
items.summary_zh: 该研究由Ternacle J、Hahn RT等PARTNER 3研究者团队完成,发表于《JAMA Cardiology》,是对PARTNER 3随机对照试验(2016年3月至2017年10月,71家美加中心共入组1000例低外科风险重度症状性主动脉瓣狭窄患者)的事后7年随访分析,纳入495例TAVR(Sapien 3瓣膜)及453例外科生物瓣患者。结果显示,7年时两组结构性瓣膜退化、全因生物瓣衰败及再干预发生率均维持在低位且组间无显著差异,提示SAPIEN 3球扩瓣在低危年轻患者中的中长期耐久性与外科生物瓣相当,为TAVR终身管理策略提供了迄今样本量最大的随机对照数据支持。
items.summary_en: In this ad hoc 7-year analysis of the PARTNER 3 randomized trial by Ternacle J, Hahn RT and the PARTNER 3 investigators, published in JAMA Cardiology, the authors followed 495 TAVR (SAPIEN 3) and 453 surgical bioprosthesis recipients among the original 1,000 low-surgical-risk patients with severe symptomatic aortic stenosis enrolled at 71 US/Canadian centers (March 2016-October 2017). At 7 years, rates of structural valve deterioration, all-cause bioprosthetic valve failure, and reintervention remained low and statistically similar between TAVR and surgery, providing the largest randomized dataset to date supporting comparable mid-to-long-term durability of the balloon-expandable valve versus surgical bioprostheses in low-risk, younger patients.

items.title: Medtronic Announces Strategic Investment in Pi-Cardia to Accelerate Innovation for Complex TAVR
items.title_zh: 美敦力宣布对Pi-Cardia战略投资最高8000万美元,并获得未来以最高2.1亿美元前期对价收购该公司的选择权,借其ShortCut瓣叶劈开装置强化复杂TAVR(瓣中瓣)产品线
items.summary_zh: 美敦力于2026年9月1日宣布,将对以色列医疗器械公司Pi-Cardia进行最高8000万美元的战略投资,并获得在达成既定里程碑后以最高2.1亿美元前期对价(外加后续潜在业绩对价)收购该公司的选择权;美敦力预计于2027年成为Pi-Cardia ShortCut装置的全球独家商业分销商。ShortCut是FDA已批准的首款瓣叶劈开技术,用于瓣中瓣TAVR术中预防冠脉阻塞这一严重并发症,在FDA审评的关键性临床研究中实现了全部入组患者的成功瓣叶劈开且安全性良好。此次交易反映了器械巨头持续加码复杂/再次TAVR这一细分赛道。
items.summary_en: On September 1, 2026, Medtronic announced a strategic investment of up to $80 million in Israeli device maker Pi-Cardia, along with an option to acquire the company for an estimated upfront price of up to $210 million upon achievement of predefined milestones, plus potential additional earn-outs; Medtronic expects to become the exclusive global commercial distributor of Pi-Cardia's ShortCut device in 2027. ShortCut is the first FDA-cleared leaflet-modification technology designed to prevent coronary obstruction during valve-in-valve TAVR, and demonstrated successful leaflet splitting in all patients in its FDA-reviewed pivotal study with a favorable safety profile — underscoring continued strategic investment by major device makers in the complex/redo-TAVR segment.

items.title: Prognostic Value of NT-proBNP in Patients Undergoing Tricuspid Valve Transcatheter Edge-to-Edge Repair: The EuroTR Registry
items.title_zh: 欧洲EuroTR三尖瓣介入登记研究(JACC: Cardiovascular Interventions,n=2282,中位年龄80岁,54%为女性,86% NYHA III-IV级):基线NT-proBNP独立预测T-TEER术后2年全因死亡或心衰住院复合终点(校正HR 1.62,95%CI 1.29-2.04)
items.summary_zh: 该研究纳入欧洲EuroTR(三尖瓣介入欧洲登记研究)队列中2282例接受经导管三尖瓣缘对缘修复(T-TEER)且有基线NT-proBNP检测的重度三尖瓣反流患者(中位年龄80岁,54%为女性,86%处于NYHA心功能III-IV级),按NT-proBNP三分位数(≤1674、1674-3743、>3743 pg/mL)分层分析。结果显示,NT-proBNP水平越高的患者合并症负担越重、双心室重构更明显、三尖瓣反流程度更严重;基线NT-proBNP水平独立预测术后2年全因死亡或首次心衰住院复合终点(校正HR 1.62,95%CI 1.29-2.04),且术后30天内NT-proBNP的早期变化在基线水平之外仍能提供额外预后信息。研究提示,联合基线值与早期变化趋势的NT-proBNP有望成为T-TEER术后简便实用的风险分层工具。
items.summary_en: This EuroTR (European Registry of Transcatheter Repair for Tricuspid Regurgitation) analysis, published in JACC: Cardiovascular Interventions, included 2,282 patients with severe tricuspid regurgitation undergoing transcatheter edge-to-edge repair (T-TEER) with available baseline NT-proBNP (median age 80, 54% women, 86% NYHA III-IV), stratified into tertiles (≤1,674, 1,674-3,743, and >3,743 pg/mL). Higher NT-proBNP tertiles were associated with greater comorbidity burden, more advanced biventricular remodeling, and more severe TR. Baseline NT-proBNP was independently associated with the primary 2-year endpoint of all-cause mortality or first heart failure hospitalization (adjusted HR 1.62, 95% CI 1.29-2.04), and early 30-day postprocedural NT-proBNP trajectories added incremental prognostic value beyond baseline — suggesting a simple, clinically applicable risk-stratification tool for T-TEER.

items.title: Development and Validation of a Predictive Risk Score for Poor Functional Outcome After Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement in Elderly Patients
items.title_zh: 河北医科大学第二医院团队开发TAVR-PRO评分(《Clinical Interventions in Aging》):纳入年龄≥80岁、衰弱、NT-proBNP>3000pg/mL、冠心病、慢性肾病5项指标,训练集AUC达0.88、验证集0.86,可预测TAVR术后6个月功能不良结局及1年死亡风险
items.summary_zh: 该研究由Hang Zhang、Jinghui An等河北医科大学第二医院心外科团队完成,发表于《Clinical Interventions in Aging》,旨在开发并验证一个预测老年TAVR患者术后6个月功能不良结局的风险评分。研究纳入高龄(≥80岁)、临床衰弱量表(CFS)>4分、NT-proBNP>3000 pg/mL、合并冠心病、慢性肾病(eGFR<45 mL/min/1.73m²)5项独立预测因素构建TAVR-PRO评分,并按0-2分、3-4分、≥5分分为低、中、高危三组。该评分在训练队列和验证队列中均显示出良好区分度(AUC分别为0.88和0.86)及校准度,评分越高患者术后功能不良结局及1年全因死亡风险显著越高(P<0.001)。作者认为该评分可作为老年TAVR患者术前共同决策与风险沟通的简便工具。
items.summary_en: In this study by Hang Zhang, Jinghui An and colleagues at the Second Hospital of Hebei Medical University, published in Clinical Interventions in Aging, the authors developed and validated a risk score predicting poor 6-month functional outcomes after TAVR in elderly patients. The TAVR-PRO score incorporates five independent predictors — age ≥80 years, Clinical Frailty Scale >4, NT-proBNP >3,000 pg/mL, coronary artery disease, and chronic kidney disease (eGFR <45 mL/min/1.73m2) — stratifying patients into low- (0-2), medium- (3-4), and high-risk (≥5) groups. The score showed good discrimination in both training (AUC 0.88) and validation (AUC 0.86) cohorts with strong calibration, and higher scores were significantly associated with poor functional outcome and increased 1-year all-cause mortality (P<.001), offering a simple tool for shared decision-making and risk communication in older TAVR candidates.

items.title: AI-Derived Pericardial Effusion Volume and Long-Term Mortality After Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation
items.title_zh: 单中心回顾性研究(《Journal of Clinical Medicine》,n=470,连续接受TAVI的重度主动脉瓣狭窄患者):基于AI从术前CT自动测量的心包积液量,并不能独立预测TAVI术后长期死亡率
items.summary_zh: 该研究发表于《Journal of Clinical Medicine》,回顾性纳入470例连续接受经导管主动脉瓣植入(TAVI)治疗重度主动脉瓣狭窄的患者,利用人工智能算法从术前CT图像自动分割并测量心包积液量,分析其与长期死亡率的关联。结果显示,AI测得的心包积液量本身并不能独立预测TAVI术后长期全因死亡率,提示其更多反映心血管淤血状态和心脏重构程度,而非独立的预后风险表型。该研究为AI辅助CT影像组学在TAVI术前评估中的应用边界提供了参考。
items.summary_en: In this retrospective single-center study published in the Journal of Clinical Medicine, the authors included 470 consecutive patients undergoing transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) for severe aortic stenosis, using an artificial-intelligence algorithm to automatically segment and quantify pericardial effusion volume on preprocedural CT. AI-derived pericardial effusion volume did not independently predict long-term all-cause mortality after TAVI, suggesting it reflects cardiovascular congestion and cardiac remodeling rather than an independent prognostic phenotype — informing the boundaries of AI-assisted CT radiomics in TAVI pre-procedural assessment.

items.title: Left atrial appendage closure with a novel nonpacifier device for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation
items.title_zh: 中国6家医院前瞻性、非随机、多中心登记研究(《Scientific Reports》,n=187,平均CHA2DS2-VASc评分4.0):新型非塞式左心耳封堵器植入成功率98.4%,6个月完全封堵率达100%,围术期重大并发症2.1%
items.summary_zh: 该研究发表于《Scientific Reports》,为一项前瞻性、非随机、多中心登记研究,在中国6家医院纳入187例卒中高风险的非瓣膜性房颤患者(平均年龄67.7±7.5岁,平均CHA2DS2-VASc评分4.0±1.6,平均HAS-BLED评分2.5±1.1),评估一款新型非塞式(nonpacifier)左心耳封堵器的安全性与有效性,主要终点为6个月有效封堵率及12个月缺血性卒中发生率。结果显示,187例中184例(98.4%)成功植入器械,4例(2.1%)发生围术期重大并发症;6个月时经食道超声评估的有效左心耳封堵率达100%(单侧95%置信区间下限98.0%)。这是该新型器械首次公布的临床数据,为其安全性和早期有效性提供了初步证据。
items.summary_en: Published in Scientific Reports, this prospective, non-randomized, multicenter registry across 6 Chinese hospitals enrolled 187 patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation at elevated stroke risk (mean age 67.7±7.5 years, mean CHA2DS2-VASc 4.0±1.6, mean HAS-BLED 2.5±1.1) to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of a novel nonpacifier left atrial appendage closure device, with endpoints of 6-month effective LAA closure and 12-month ischemic stroke incidence. Device implantation succeeded in 184 of 187 patients (98.4%), with 4 (2.1%) major peri-procedural complications; effective LAA closure on transesophageal echocardiography was achieved in 100% of patients at 6 months (one-sided 95% lower confidence bound 98.0%) — the first published clinical evidence for this novel occluder, supporting its early safety and effectiveness.
